get.description:
Returns company information associated with the supplied IP address.

Company fields may be null when the IP address is known but a company relationship could
not be determined. A `404` is returned only when no record exists for the IP address. When a `404`
is returned, our backend systems will automatically begin resolving the IP so that it becomes
available soon.

Requires the `ip:read` scope on the Bearer token. A `403` is returned if the scope is absent.

**Rate limiting:** This route has an elevated WAF per-client rate limit of 1,000 req/s
(vs. 60 req/s for all other routes) and is exempt from the app-level data burst limit.
A `429` is returned with a `Retry-After` header if a limit is exceeded.

parameters.name: x-client-id
parameters.description: Client identifier matching the authenticated token

parameters.name: ipAddress
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up

200.description: Company record for the given IP address. Company fields may be null when the IP address is known but a company relationship could not be determined.

403.description: Forbidden – invalid token, client mismatch, or missing `ip:read` scope

filterAdUnits.name: filter
filterAdUnits.description:
Filter results by field values using the syntax `filter[<field>][<op>]=<value>`.

Operators by field type:
- **string**: `eq`, `ne`, `in`, `notIn`, `isNull`, `isNotNull`
- **number**: `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `in`, `notIn`, `isNull`, `isNotNull`
- **boolean**: `eq`, `ne`, `isNull`, `isNotNull`
- **date**: `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `isNull`, `isNotNull`

For `in` and `notIn`, provide comma-separated values: `filter[tag_id][in]=a,b,c`.
For `isNull` and `isNotNull`, the value is ignored.

Multiple filters are combined with AND.

Examples:
- `filter[ad_unit_id][eq]=unt_abc123`
- `filter[ad_unit_name][in]=Leaderboard,Rectangle`
- `filter[is_deleted][eq]=false`

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description:
Opaque pagination token from the previous response’s `nextCursor`. Omit on the first page.

Page size is controlled by the `limit` query parameter (default 200, maximum 1000).

listLimit.name: limit
listLimit.description:
Maximum number of records to return in this page.
Omit to use the default (200); the maximum allowed value is 1000.
Values above the maximum return HTTP 400 with code `err:pulsar.request.invalid-limit`.

BadRequest.description: Bad request – missing client_id or client_secret (code `err:pulsar.auth.missing-credentials`)

NotFound.description: Not found – no matching route or resource (code `err:pulsar.core.not-found`)

TooManyRequests.description:
Rate limit exceeded – too many requests from this client.

Limits:
- `POST /auth/token`: 20 req/min per `client_id` (app), plus WAF per-IP limit
- `/events/*` and `/dimensions/*`: burst limit of 100 req / 10s per client (app)
- All authenticated routes: WAF 60 req/s per `x-client-id` (5-minute window)
- `/ip/*` routes: WAF elevated tier (app burst limit does not apply)

App-level limits can be disabled via `PULSAR_APP_RATE_LIMITS=0|false|off` (WAF still applies).

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying

bearerAuth.description:
M2M Bearer token issued by Stytch. Pass as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Example: `Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...`

clientId.name: x-client-id
clientId.description:
Client identifier that must match the `client_id` claim in the Bearer token.

Example: `x-client-id: m2m-client-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000`
